{{Quote|The best bet here in Axial Park is the Corellian Museum of Starships&mdash;they have a big, open-air landing pad that our people can slip right onto.|General Garza|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Corellian Museum of Starships''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located in [[Axial Park]], a district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the capital of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the museum displayed ships such as a [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighter]], the [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] ''[[Lucky Lancer]]'', and an [[Imperial assault shuttle]].
